findings.topic: Half normalization and exact full gate products
findings.finding: canonicalPolynomial_half transports the actual inverse of 2 through the rational constant ring map; the polynomial-ring Invertible 2 instance is already proved. The two weight identities unfold products over every k : Fin (parts-1). Each ordinary factor is the prescribed half-difference of the actual near/far entries; each root factor is the prescribed half-sum, obtained by negating the whole H array. Commutativity only moves the half scalar. Fin 0 products remain 1 for unary compositions; binary factors retain their existing exact definitions.

findings.topic: Unrestricted polynomial identity and physical root
findings.finding: canonicalTreePolynomial_farOnly is an equality in MvPolynomial (IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) rationals before evaluation. It rewrites the actual rooted recursion weights, then invokes the arbitrary-ring FormalNearFarRecursion result. formalBoundaryChi g is the reverse order upper,middle,lower in boundaryIndex g k = g+k+1, expressed as a fixed signed canonical physical-triple variable. Arbitrary g is retained, with fullBoundaryInterval 0 to n-1 for every hn : 3 <= n, including n=3. No root-independence claim or root restriction is inserted.

eval_canonicalTreePolynomial_farOnly quantifies over arbitrary LabelledTuple P, with no G1 or WeakGeneric premise. map_farOnlyOutput transports the complete inverse and reversed output through polynomial evaluation; eval_formalBoundaryChi identifies the entire evaluated array with the actual rational geometricBoundaryArray.
